I’m logging off twitter for a few days.  But, before I go, I just want to send my support to Christine Blasley Ford.

I believe you. I support you. 

#MeToo

#TimesUp

TW: sexual assault 

I grew up in a religious/conservative household.

I was never taught the concept of consent growing up. I was taught abstinence.

The reason I never reported my #metoo experiences: I did not understand that my consent had been violated at the time.
